effects.instruction: Narrator only: Battle Trial round 3 of 5 is on now: Team B (Shoto Todoroki and Mezo Shoji) as heroes against Team I (Mashirao Ojiro and Toru Hagakure) as villains. Only Mashirao Ojiro and Toru Hagakure are villains; nobody else joins them. Already fought, never again: Teams A, D, J, E. Announce and play only this matchup. When it ends, the next round is Team H (Fumikage Tokoyami and Tsuyu Asui) against Team C (Momo Yaoyorozu and Minoru Mineta); Teams A, D, J, E, B, I are then done and never drawn again. The exercise is NOT over after this round: 2 more rounds remain. If the story sums up the rest of the trial in one turn, the remaining rounds are exactly: 4. Tokoyami/Asui vs Yaoyorozu/Mineta; 5. Jiro/Kaminari vs Koda/Sato; Hanta Sero fights in none of them. Nobody else fights. When this round ends, close the turn with its result and a short review; announce the next round only on the following turn.
